positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on new features for web and mobile web on the YouTube Main App Web team.

positions.title: Scholar Lead
positions.description: I provided on-campus peer mentorship to newly selected Opportunity scholars each year at UW Seattle under the supervision of the WSOS Scholar Success team. Scholar Leads are enthusiastic role models who help Scholars navigate their new campus, learn about available resources and support their academic journey. Responsibilities also include sharing resources that support goal setting, prioritization of work, and time management.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: On the YouTube Main App Web Team, I implemented a new feature for YouTube videos in error states using server-side C++, TypeScript, and the Polymer Library. Additionally, I worked on various smaller projects. The side projects included fixing an accessibility issue on the homepage and creating a TypeScript library to manage toasts/snackbars.

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description: In a pod of three, we developed a web application using React and Firebase to help users find and play board games that match their interests while connecting with others virtually. Most notably, I implemented the day phase of the game Mafia while continually testing for bugs and scalability. Additionally, I created a personal portfolio using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Java servlets, and Google App Engine.

positions.title: Dog Aging Project Intern
positions.description: I created a SQL stored procedure to find and mark hundreds of duplicate participant records that were discarded from the study. Additionally, I significantly slashed the Dog Aging Project online dashboard loading time by periodically calculating and storing data into a table using C#, LINQ, and the Entity Framework.

positions.title: Forms Building - Customer Support
positions.description: I created digital forms, such as student questionnaires and applications, upon emailed requests by private schools. With attention to detail, I completed many forms that would be used by thousands of applying students for that academic year.

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteered for many free events for children and teens, such as Family Day, where I was managed craft tables and welcomed families to the event.
